name: UIcockpit
description: A design system you configure once and can then prove: framework-neutral CSS tokens over semantic HTML, with a verifier that checks a codebase against the contract it was given. Built to WCAG 2.2 AA, with an AAA target-size mode for public-sector baselines.

components.name: Accordion
components.definition: Stacked disclosure panels — one section open at a time or many.

components.name: Alert
components.definition: An inline message in the toned status colours — info, success, warning, danger.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.definition: A confirmation modal that names the object and its destructive action.

components.name: Avatar
components.definition: A user image or initials, with sizes and a status dot.

components.name: Badge & Chip
components.definition: Compact status pills and removable chips in the toned status colours.

components.name: Banner
components.definition: A full-width page-level notice with an action and a dismiss.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.definition: A path trail back up the hierarchy, with a truncating overflow.

components.name: Button
components.definition: The primary action control — one loud primary per region, quiet siblings, a locked height scale.

components.name: Button Group
components.definition: Segmented actions that share one seam — a split button or a related-action cluster.

components.name: Carousel
components.definition: Sliding panels with prev/next and dot pagination.

components.name: Character Count
components.definition: A live remaining-characters readout that is actually announced, and never truncates a paste.

components.name: Chart
components.definition: Line / area / bar / stacked / donut on the kit’s derived 6-series palette.

components.name: Checkbox & Radio
components.definition: Multi- and single-select controls, including the richer selectable card variant.

components.name: Code Block
components.definition: A mono code surface with a header, copy button and language tag.

components.name: Combobox
components.definition: Type-ahead select: filter a list as you type, keyboard-navigable.

components.name: Command Palette
components.definition: The ⌘K launcher — searchable actions with sections, shortcuts and keyboard flow.

components.name: Context Menu
components.definition: Right-click actions on a surface — the same menu vocabulary, summoned in place.

components.name: Data Table
components.definition: The flagship data surface — toolbar, selection, sticky header, pagination and every state.

components.name: Date Picker
components.definition: A date field whose popover calendar is pure kit — themed, not OS chrome.

components.name: Description List
components.definition: Key–value pairs — account info, plan details, a spec sheet.

components.name: Dialog
components.definition: A focused modal — one screen of content, one primary action in a sunken foot.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.definition: A trigger that opens a themed menu of actions, with sections, shortcuts and destructive items.

components.name: Empty State
components.definition: The zero-data screen — an icon, a line of guidance and one action.

components.name: Entity Card
components.definition: An identity + a few key facts — mark, name, a kebab menu and meta rows.

components.name: File Upload
components.definition: A drag-and-drop dropzone with browse fallback and file-type hints.

components.name: Filter Bar
components.definition: Search, facets and removable active-filter chips — the query surface for any list.

components.name: Footer
components.definition: The contentinfo landmark — accessibility statement, privacy, contact, the body responsible.

components.name: Form Panel
components.definition: The full form block — sectioned fields, inline validation and a sunken action bar.

components.name: Hover Card
components.definition: A richer hover preview — a profile or link card summoned on dwell.

components.name: Identifier
components.definition: Who operates this service, and the statements a person is entitled to find.

components.name: In-page Navigation
components.definition: On this page — a named nav landmark whose current item is announced, not just underlined.

components.name: Input
components.definition: The text field and its label/hint/error anatomy — the base of every form.

components.name: Input OTP
components.definition: A one-time-code field — separated single-character cells.

components.name: Lightbox
components.definition: A full-screen media viewer with prev/next and a caption.

components.name: List
components.definition: Rows of items with lead media, meta and trailing actions or badges.

components.name: Memorable Date
components.definition: Three fields for a date someone already knows — the accessible answer to date entry, not a picker.

components.name: Menubar
components.definition: A desktop-style top menu bar with nested menus — File / Edit / View.

components.name: Navigation Menu
components.definition: A top nav with dropdown mega-panels for sections.

components.name: Number Input
components.definition: A numeric field with stepper affordances and tabular alignment.

components.name: Pagination
components.definition: Page controls with prev/next and a windowed page range.

components.name: Password Input
components.definition: A password field with a reveal toggle and caps-lock warning.

components.name: Phone Input
components.definition: A phone field with a country-code select add-on.

components.name: Popover
components.definition: A small floating panel anchored to a trigger, for quick forms and pickers.

components.name: Process List
components.definition: Numbered steps that carry real content — editorial, not a progress indicator.

components.name: Progress
components.definition: A determinate progress bar, heavier than the slider to read as ongoing work.

components.name: Prose
components.definition: A rich-text container that styles raw semantic tags to the kit’s type and rhythm.

components.name: Reasoning
components.definition: The model’s thinking disclosure — “Thought for 12s”, collapsed by default.

components.name: Requirements Checklist
components.definition: Rules that tick off as you type, announced politely, with met/unmet carried in text.

components.name: Resizable
components.definition: Drag-to-resize split panes with a grabbable handle.

components.name: Search Input
components.definition: A search field with a lead icon, ghost clear button and optional kbd hint.

components.name: Select
components.definition: A themed select trigger + option menu — the native picker, restyled to the kit.

components.name: Sheet
components.definition: A slide-in panel from an edge — a longer flow than a dialog holds.

components.name: Skeleton
components.definition: Loading placeholders that match the shape of what’s coming.

components.name: Slider
components.definition: A drag-to-set value control on a stroke-3 track with a precise handle.

components.name: Spinner
components.definition: An indeterminate loading indicator at the control-height scale.

components.name: Stat Tile
components.definition: A KPI tile — big number, label, delta and an optional sparkline.

components.name: Stepper
components.definition: A multi-step progress indicator — done, current and future states.

components.name: Switch
components.definition: A binary toggle with a shape-locked round knob and the kit’s motion.

components.name: Table
components.definition: The base data table — header, rows, numeric alignment, hover and zebra.

components.name: Tabs
components.definition: A tab strip that switches panels, with an active underline and keyboard flow.

components.name: Tag Input
components.definition: Enter and remove tokens inline — labels, recipients, filters.

components.name: Timeline
components.definition: Vertical events with state dots — activity feeds, build history, version logs.

components.name: Toast
components.definition: Transient confirmations — the toned variants and the actionable snackbar.

components.name: Tool Call
components.definition: An AI agent’s tool receipt — mono name, args, a status dot and an expandable result.

components.name: Toolbar
components.definition: A row of grouped controls at one locked height — the editor/table action bar.

components.name: Tooltip
components.definition: A hover hint — one line of context, never interactive content.

components.name: Usage Meter
components.definition: A quota bar whose fill shifts to a warning tone past a threshold.
